instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: rhythm games deserve a big comeback.

Guitar Hero III got people who never touched games to grab a plastic guitar at parties. Rock Band put four friends on drums, bass, guitar and mic in one living room. Dance Dance Revolution got whole arcades sweating. Nothing today replaces that. Agree?
